name: billycord
description: BillyCord - A full-featured chat application with real-time messaging, voice channels, and server management

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build && ELECTRON_DEV=true npx electron .
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && node scripts/generate-icons.js && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build && node scripts/generate-icons.js && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npx electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build && node scripts/generate-icons.js && npx electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build && node scripts/generate-icons.js && npx electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.config.js
